headline: Colombia Trade Deficit Widens to $2.27 Billion in September
summary: Colombia's trade deficit doubled year-on-year to $2.27 billion in September, driven by increased imports of machinery, chemicals, and natural gas.
why: Trade balances provide essential insight into foreign currency demand and current account deficits.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: A widening trade shortfall increases pressure on external debt financing and the national currency.
